name: Nikoo Homes 6
address: Kogilu Main Road, Kogilu, Yelahanka, Bengaluru, Karnataka
description: Nikoo Homes 6 is a garden-led apartment development at Kogilu, with flexible home formats and shared recreation centred on the Black Swan Club. Developer material includes study-room, loft and larger family-home options, alongside gardens and indoor and outdoor activity spaces. The project combines different household layouts within a common landscape and community setting.

content.faqsTitle: Six things to know about Nikoo Homes 6

faqs.question: Where exactly is Nikoo Homes 6 located?
faqs.answer: Kogilu Main Road, Kogilu, Yelahanka, Bengaluru, Karnataka, 560064. The Google Maps link uses this project and address.

faqs.question: What configurations and sizes are documented?
faqs.answer: Studio, One Bed, Two Bed, Two Bed With Study, Three Bed, Three Bed With Study, Four Bed With Staff, Loft. Documented saleable/super built-up plan areas span 470–2502 sq ft. The layout table identifies each area basis and applicable phase.

faqs.question: What is the published starting price?
faqs.answer: ₹55.23 L–₹2.94 Cr* Onward. The pricing record identifies the source and quoted configuration. Unpriced formats are excluded from the reference range; a current cost sheet is needed for the selected unit. Applicable charges are itemised separately by the source.

faqs.question: What is the status and possession timeline?
faqs.answer: Under construction. Published timeline: Phase 1 January 2029; Phase 2 September 2029, secondary registry references. The date differs by phase and must be matched to the offered home.

faqs.question: What are the main amenities?
faqs.answer: Swimming Pool, Kids Play Area, Multi Purpose Court, Indoor Gym, Kids Pool, Squash Court. No reconciled unique total in the primary material used. These are published facilities; confirm which are completed and accessible to your selected phase.

faqs.question: What makes this project worth comparing?
faqs.answer: Kogilu location Study room loft and larger family home formats Black Swan Club. Aaramv can compare these features with your space needs, budget and daily routes, and help coordinate the next steps through move-in.
